task: Task B: one verdict per speaker per whole episode
protocol: 5-fold episode-disjoint cross-validation over all 147 speaker units; no episode appears in both sides of a fold

system_notes.majority_class: floor: always predict the training fold's most common verdict
system_notes.tfidf_speaker_script: control: TF-IDF over the speaker's concatenated script
system_notes.hierarchical_banglabert: the Task B model: attention pooling over turn embeddings
system_notes.oracle_aggregated_gold_turns: not a model; the judge's own gold turn labels aggregated word-weighted, so it bounds any turn-aggregation route

caveat: scores measure agreement with the LLM judge's holistic verdict, not with human ground truth
